title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.13276v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid evolution of Embodied AI has enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to excel in multimodal perception and task execution. However, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to these massive models in large-scale distributed environments faces severe systemic bottlenecks, primarily due to the resource conflict between high-fidelity physical simulation and the intensive VRAM/bandwidth demands of deep learning. This conflict often leaves overall throughput constrained by execution-phase inefficiencies. translated_title: D-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的高并发分布式异步强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 具身智能的快速发展使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多模态感知与任务执行方面表现出色。然而，在大规模分布式环境中对这类大型模型应用强化学习（RL）面临严重的系统性瓶颈，其主要源于高保真物理仿真与深度学习对显存和带宽的密集需求之间的资源冲突。这种冲突往往导致整体吞吐量受制于执行阶段的低效问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了D-VLA，一个面向大规模具身基础模型的高并发、低延迟分布式强化学习框架。D-VLA引入了“平面解耦”机制，将高频训练数据与低频权重控制进行物理隔离，从而消除仿真与优化之间的相互干扰。我们进一步设计了四线程异步的“泳道”流水线，实现（原文在此处截断）
tldr: D-VLA提出了一个面向大规模视觉-语言-动作模型的高并发分布式异步强化学习框架，通过“平面解耦”隔离训练数据与权重控制、四线程异步“泳道”流水线实现完全并行，解决了仿真与深度学习间的资源冲突并大幅提升系统吞吐量。
en_tdlr: D-VLA is a high-concurrency distributed asynchronous reinforcement learning framework for large-scale Vision-Language-Action models, which resolves resource conflicts between simulation and deep learning through "Plane Decoupling" and a four-thread asynchronous "Swimlane" pipeline to significantly improve system throughput.
